name: One-on-One Meeting
description: Notes for recurring 1:1 meetings between a manager and team member: wins, blockers, feedback, and action items.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: One paragraph capturing the tone and substance of the conversation.

sections.title: Wins & Progress
sections.instruction: What went well since the last meeting. Note completed work and achievements with specifics.

sections.title: Blockers & Challenges
sections.instruction: What is stuck or slowing the person down, and what support was discussed.

sections.title: Feedback Exchanged
sections.instruction: Feedback given and received, both constructive and positive. Be specific and reference the topic.

sections.title: Career & Growth
sections.instruction: Any discussion of development, goals, skills, or trajectory.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: All committed actions with owners and due dates. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Action | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Topics for Next Time
sections.instruction: Anything parked or deferred to the next 1:1.
